interface.title: SEM measurement tool
interface.field: Electron microscopy / materials and microfabrication metrology
interface.stage_of_work: Image analysis and measurement of acquired micrographs
interface.what_it_is_for: Calibrate an SEM image's pixel scale and tilt, then trace contours and place rulers, angles and edge-squared line profiles that snap to edges, and export them as CSV, polygon/GDSII files or a session file.

data.note: coins.png (384 x 303, uint8), opened with Open image…. It has no microscope metadata (the Metadata panel says so), so I typed in a pixel size of 50 nm × 50 nm by hand. No real SEM TIFF or .txt/.hdr metadata file was available.

tree.general: Measure the size and shape of features in a micrograph in physical units and export the results
tree.specific: Calibrate coins.png, trace coins, place rulers, angles and profiles, and export CSV/GDS/session

features.name: Edge-snapping polygon outline with vertex table
features.general: Click around an object to outline it with points that settle on its boundary, then edit the points in a table and read off perimeter, area and bounding box in physical units
features.specific: Contour tool (1) with snap clicks to the strongest nearby edge; Ctrl+click inserts, right-click deletes, N starts a new one, C closes or opens it, and T opens the Vertices window with Up/Down/Drop/First/Reverse/Zoom
steps: Choose the contour tool
Click points around the feature (they snap to the edge)
Ctrl+click to insert or right-click to delete a vertex
Toggle closed/open polygon
Open the vertex table to reorder, reverse or zoom to a vertex
Read perimeter or length, area and bounding box
serves_tasks: Outline a feature and read its perimeter, area and bounding box

features.name: Line profile with averaging band, auto-squaring and A/B markers
features.general: Draw a line across a boundary, average the intensity over a band of adjustable width, keep the line perpendicular to the boundary, and place two markers on the plot to measure the distance between slopes
features.specific: Profile tool (5) with its profile window: band width field or drag handle, ⊥ Square / E, 'square profiles to the edge they cross', and markers A/B snapped to the steepest slope, then Export CSV/PNG
steps: Click both ends of a profile across an edge (it turns square by up to 15°; Alt keeps it as drawn)
Set the band width, or drag the band's square handle
Press ⊥ Square if the line is further off square
Click the plot to place A and B, and drag them to move
Export the samples as CSV or the plot as PNG
serves_tasks: Take an intensity profile across an edge, averaged over a band and square to the edge
Take a second profile exactly as drawn
Measure an edge-to-edge distance on a profile
Export the profile's data and plot

features.name: Pixel calibration with tilt correction and frame rotation
features.general: Turn pixel coordinates into physical units, stretching for a tilted sample, and rotate or re-origin the coordinate frame
features.specific: Scale, tilt and rotation panel: pixel width/height (nm, height fills in from width), stage tilt θ, tilt correction (none / cross-section / tilted surface / custom k), tilt axis α, rotation φ, Rotation 0°, Set/Reset origin
steps: Enter the pixel width (the height fills in to match)
Optionally enter stage tilt and choose a correction (shows k)
Optionally set the tilt axis or rotation
Set the origin by clicking a point
Watch all measurement readouts update
serves_tasks: Set the physical size of a pixel by hand so readouts are in micrometres

features.name: Ruler that levels the image or sets the tilt axis
features.general: Measure a distance between two points, then use that line to align the image horizontally or vertically or to define an axis
features.specific: Ruler tool (2) with Level: horizontal (H), Level: vertical (V) and Tilt axis along ruler; Ctrl+Z undoes
steps: Click two ends of a ruler
Read length, ΔX, ΔY and direction
Press Level: horizontal or vertical to turn the image
Or press Tilt axis along ruler to copy its direction into α
Undo with Ctrl+Z

features.name: Measurement list with multi-select export
features.general: Keep every measurement in one list, select some or all, and download them as a table, as vertex files or as layout geometry
features.specific: Measurements listbox (click, Ctrl/Shift+click, Ctrl+A, arrow keys, double-click) with Download ▾ (one row each CSV, contour vertices CSV, GDS… dialog with cell name, path width and text labels), Rename and Delete
steps: Select one or more measurements in the list
Open Download ▾
Choose rows CSV, vertices CSV or GDS
Fill in the GDS dialog and export
Rename or delete entries
serves_tasks: Export all measurements as a table
Export outlines as vertex lists or chip-layout geometry

features.name: Edge detector tuning with edge map overlay
features.general: Adjust how boundaries are detected (smoothing, noise filter, search radius, strength threshold) and see the detected edges over the image
features.specific: Snapping to edges panel: smoothing σ, median prefilter, search radius, min. edge strength, and show the edge map (G)
steps: Turn on show the edge map
Change smoothing σ or the median prefilter
See the edge map get thinner or thicker
Turn the overlay off and measure with the tuned snapping
serves_tasks: Check and tune what point clicks settle on at feature boundaries

features.name: Histogram display levels
features.general: Set the displayed grey range by dragging black and white levels on a histogram, with an automatic option
features.specific: Display panel: histogram with draggable black/white markers, black/white level fields, brightness/contrast sliders, Auto, Full range, log counts
steps: Drag the white (or black) level marker on the histogram
Optionally tick log counts
Press Auto (or Full range) to reset
serves_tasks: Adjust how grey values are displayed

features.name: Session save and restore
features.general: Save every measurement, the calibration and the settings to one file, and reopen it later to continue the work
features.specific: Save session (downloads <image>_session.json) and Open session… (restore not verified in this run)
steps: Press Save session to download the session file
Later, open the same image
Press Open session… and choose the saved file (not verified)
serves_tasks: Save the whole session for later
